releaseNotes:
• Smoother, hang-free player — the VLC engine now starts ONLY when your phone truly can't decode a video (slow or buffering streams no longer switch to it), and pressing Back never freezes the app
• Hamyra HD (Hindi) now plays first on Hindi movies & series; Hindi audio is selected by default
• Pull to refresh on Home — new pinned titles (Bachelor Point, Sultan Salahuddin) show up without clearing app data
• MovieLinkBD titles now show only their own details and "More like this" — no more mismatched TMDB suggestions
• Live TV & Sports players sit below the status bar, and the video box keeps one steady 16:9 size
• HEVC / 4K plays smoothly with the same controls, auto Bangla subtitles on every server, YouTube fallback and many speed & stability fixes

Thank you for your support!
